description:
MiniMax H3 Max — fal's post-trained H3.

Modes determined by inputs:
- Text-to-video: prompt only (aspect_ratio required, no adaptive)
- Image-to-video: prompt + image and/or end_image (first frame, last frame, or both)
- Reference: prompt + reference images/videos/audio (aspect_ratio defaults to adaptive)

prompt.description: Video prompt. Max 50000 chars. Use timeline markers like [0s-3s] for scene pacing.
examples: A cinematic tracking shot through a misty forest at dawn, golden light filtering through ancient trees.
prompt.title: Prompt

image.description: First frame image for image-to-video. Formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, AVIF.
image.title: Image

end_image.description: Last frame image. Can be given alone for end-only generation; the canvas then follows this image.
end_image.title: End Image

target_audio.description: Audio clip (2s or longer, max 15 MB) pinned as the soundtrack. Trimmed to the video length. Text-to-video and image-to-video only; use duration of at least 2s.
target_audio.title: Target Audio

reference_images.description: Reference images for style/subject guidance (max 9). Cannot combine with first/last frame.
reference_images.title: Reference Images

reference_videos.description: Reference videos for motion/style (max 3). MP4, 2-15s each.
reference_videos.title: Reference Videos

reference_audios.description: Reference audio clips (max 3). Requires reference image or video. 2-15s each.
reference_audios.title: Reference Audios

duration.description: Video duration in seconds (1-15). Output can run up to ~0.7s longer than requested.
duration.title: Duration

resolution.description: Output resolution. 480P fastest, 768P native quality, 1080P latent refinement from 768P (slowest, priciest).

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio. Text-to-video requires explicit value (not adaptive). Reference mode defaults to adaptive.

prompt_expansion_mode.description: Prompt rewriting effort: disabled (none), balanced (~1s), or quality (~30s extra) for richer rewriting.

title: AppInput
